reply_text:
I found no new dated AI prediction by Mark Zuckerberg from 2023. That's partly because I couldn't open the parts of his interviews most likely to contain one. I didn't come across any of the three claims you already have on file.

**What I read in his own words:**
- **Senate AI Insight Forum remarks (13 September 2023, Meta's own post).** The only future-looking AI line is conditional, with no date: if "at some point in the future these systems get close to the level of superintelligence, then these equities will shift and we'll reconsider this approach."
- **First-quarter earnings call (26 April 2023, Meta's official transcript).** The only time limit is loose: "I'm incredibly excited to ship more of the things that we're building over the coming months." "Over the coming months" isn't a stated length, so I left it out. The rest of the AI section talks about direction ("over time", "AI agents to billions of people") without dates. The firm dated forecasts on that call are about Reels revenue and a new headset, not AI.
- **Lex Fridman Podcast #383 (8 June 2023).** The transcript I could open is from uListen, a podcast summary site, not Lex Fridman's own site. It is labelled partial and stops at about minute 46. In it he says a model closer to superintelligence would need more discussion and adds "I, I think there's a good chance that we're pretty far off from that position." That's about when superintelligence arrives but gives no date, so it goes under undated. The episode's "AGI timeline" chapter starts at about 2:25:55, beyond what that transcript covers.
- **The Verge's Decoder interview (27 September 2023).** The Podchaser transcript is cut short and the AI part has no dated claims.

**Gaps:** the 2023 transcript I most wanted, from Lex Fridman's site, never turned up in search, and another transcript site (transcriptforest) wouldn't open. I didn't reach the Connect 2023 keynote, the second- and third-quarter earnings calls, or the September Lex Fridman metaverse episode (#398). I used all 6 page openings and 7 of the 12 searches. Since I had no openings left, I didn't spend the other 5 searches. The best next steps are the AGI-timeline segment of #383 and the third-quarter call.
